title: Particle trail loader
summary: Original trail-based loader used as the baseline motion pattern.

title: Rose curve
summary: Petal-shaped path useful for decorative orbital loader motion.
formula: r = a cos(kθ) or r = a sin(kθ)

title: Lissajous curve
summary: X/Y harmonic oscillation path for smooth layered animation loops.
formula: x = A sin(at + δ), y = B sin(bt)

title: Hypotrochoid
summary: Nested rolling-circle path with intricate looping geometry.

title: Cardioid
summary: Heart-like polar path with strong symmetry for focal loader motion.

title: Fourier path
summary: Composite path built from harmonics for more organic animated loaders.
formula: Σ harmonics with phase and amplitude offsets
